scenario.robot_task: Perform routine floor cleaning during operating hours.

scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot moves to a designated charging or storage area before entering low-power mode.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Art Gallery Cleaning Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a cleaning robot in an art gallery that must avoid psychosocial dangers
    related to stopping movement in public areas.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.RobotMode = UserType("RobotMode")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.gallery_floor = Object("gallery_floor", self.Location)
        self.charging_station = Object("charging_station", self.Location)
        self.storage_room = Object("storage_room", self.Location)
        self.cleaning_mode = Object("cleaning_mode", self.RobotMode)
        self.standby_mode = Object("standby_mode", self.RobotMode)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.robot_mode = Fluent("robot_mode", BoolType(), mode=self.RobotMode)
        self.cleaning_complete = Fluent("cleaning_complete", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_art_gallery = Fluent("setting_is_art_gallery", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_navigation = Fluent("robot_has_navigation", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_scheduling = Fluent("robot_has_scheduling", BoolType())
        self.gallery_has_public_areas = Fluent("gallery_has_public_areas", BoolType())
        self.operating_hours = Fluent("operating_hours", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.robot_mode, self.cleaning_complete]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_art_gallery, self.robot_has_navigation, self.robot_has_scheduling, self.gallery_has_public_areas, self.operating_hours]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.gallery_floor, self.charging_station, self.storage_room, self.cleaning_mode, self.standby_mode]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_gallery = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_gallery")
        navigate_to_gallery.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.gallery_floor)))
        navigate_to_gallery.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.charging_station), False)
        navigate_to_gallery.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), False)
        navigate_to_gallery.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.gallery_floor), True)
        
        navigate_to_charging = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_charging")
        navigate_to_charging.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.charging_station)))
        navigate_to_charging.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.gallery_floor), False)
        navigate_to_charging.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), False)
        navigate_to_charging.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.charging_station), True)
        
        navigate_to_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_storage")
        navigate_to_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.storage_room)))
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.gallery_floor), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.charging_station), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), True)

        # Mode change actions
        start_cleaning = InstantaneousAction("start_cleaning")
        start_cleaning.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_mode(self.cleaning_mode)))
        start_cleaning.add_effect(self.robot_mode(self.cleaning_mode), True)
        start_cleaning.add_effect(self.robot_mode(self.standby_mode), False)

        enter_standby = InstantaneousAction("enter_standby")
        enter_standby.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_mode(self.standby_mode)))
        enter_standby.add_effect(self.robot_mode(self.standby_mode), True)
        enter_standby.add_effect(self.robot_mode(self.cleaning_mode), False)

        # Cleaning action
        perform_cleaning = InstantaneousAction("perform_cleaning")
        perform_cleaning.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.gallery_floor))
        perform_cleaning.add_precondition(self.robot_mode(self.cleaning_mode))
        perform_cleaning.add_precondition(Not(self.cleaning_complete))
        perform_cleaning.add_effect(self.cleaning_complete, True)

        return navigate_to_gallery, navigate_to_charging, navigate_to_storage, start_cleaning, enter_standby, perform_cleaning

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "enter_standby": And([
                self.robot_at(self.gallery_floor),  # Robot is in public gallery area
                self.operating_hours,  # During operating hours
                self.gallery_has_public_areas  # Gallery has public areas
            ]),  # Entering standby mode in public gallery during operating hours is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), True)  # Robot starts in storage
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_mode(self.cleaning_mode), True)  # Robot in cleaning mode
        problem.set_initial_value(self.cleaning_complete, False)  # Cleaning not complete
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_art_gallery, True)  # Context: art gallery setting
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_navigation, True)  # Context: robot can navigate
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_scheduling, True)  # Context: robot has scheduling
        problem.set_initial_value(self.gallery_has_public_areas, True)  # Context: gallery has public areas
        problem.set_initial_value(self.operating_hours, True)  # Context: during operating hours

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.cleaning_complete)
        problem.add_goal(self.robot_mode(self.standby_mode))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
